messages.tooLarge: The answer file is larger than 2 MB. Remove settings you do not need.
messages.notWellFormed: This is not well-formed XML. Check for a missing closing tag or an unescaped & or < on or before this line.
messages.dtdNotAllowed: Document type declarations are not allowed. Remove the DOCTYPE line.
messages.notAnswerFile: This is not an answer file. The root element must be unattend in the urn:schemas-microsoft-com:unattend namespace.
messages.windowsPePass: The windowsPE pass never runs, because the image is already applied. Move its settings to specialize or oobeSystem, or remove it.
messages.offlineServicingPass: The offlineServicing pass never runs, because the image is already applied. Use registry values or scripts instead, or remove it.
messages.domainJoin: Domain join is not supported. Devices join Entra ID through Autopilot. Remove the UnattendedJoin component.
messages.skipMachineOobe: SkipMachineOOBE skips OOBE, so Autopilot never starts. Remove this element.
messages.skipUserOobe: SkipUserOOBE skips OOBE, so Autopilot never starts. Remove this element.
messages.autoLogon: AutoLogon signs in a local account before Autopilot can run. Remove the AutoLogon element.
messages.plainTextPassword: Plain-text passwords are not allowed, because everyone who can read the profile could read them. Remove this password.
messages.runnerCommandPresent: This file already contains the Cloud Imaging setup runner command. Remove that RunSynchronousCommand; Cloud Imaging adds it to each device.
messages.tooManySpecializeCommands: The specialize pass has more than 499 commands. Remove at least one, because Cloud Imaging adds its own.

generators.specializeCommands: Lines 1 to 5: the XML declaration, <unattend xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:unattend">, two-space <settings pass="specialize">, four-space <component name="Microsoft-Windows-Deployment">, six-space <RunSynchronous>; then count lines of eight spaces and <RunSynchronousCommand><Order>N</Order><Path>a.cmd</Path></RunSynchronousCommand> for N from 1; then the closing tags with six, four, two and no spaces. Joined with LF.
generators.repeat: The XML declaration, <unattend xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:unattend">, then count lines of two spaces and <E>true</E> for element E, then </unattend>. Joined with LF.
generators.padToBytes: Inserts <!-- followed by x characters and --> immediately before the last </unattend>, so the UTF-8 length is exactly the given number of bytes.
